commands: cd /workspace/terraform && ./terraform show -json | jq -r '.values.root_module | recurse(.child_modules[]?) | .resources[]? | select(.type == "aws_instance" or .type == "aws_security_group" or .type == "aws_launch_template") | .address' | head -30

cat /tmp/state.json | jq '[.values.root_module | recurse(.child_modules[]?) | .resources[]? | select(.type == "aws_instance" or .type == "aws_security_group" or .type == "aws_launch_template") | {address, type, values: (.values | {id, region: .availability_zone, security_groups, vpc_security_group_ids, launch_template, tags})}] | .[]' 2>/dev/null

cat /tmp/state.json | jq '.values.root_module | recurse(.child_modules[]?) | .resources[]? | select(.type == "aws_security_group" or .type == "aws_security_group_rule") | {address, type, values: {id: .values.id, name: .values.name, ingress: .values.ingress, egress: .values.egress}}'

cat /tmp/state.json | jq '.values.root_module | recurse(.child_modules[]?) | .resources[]? | select(.type == "aws_security_group" and (.values.name == "default" or .values.id == "sg-default"))' | head -100

cat /tmp/state.json | jq -r ' .values.root_module | recurse(.child_modules[]?) | .resources[]? | select(.type == "aws_instance") | { instance_name: .values.tags.Name, instance_id: .values.id, region: .values.availability_zone, security_groups: .values.vpc_security_group_ids } ' | jq -s ' map( . as $instance | .security_groups as $sgs | { instance_name: .instance_name, instance_id: .instance_id, region: .region, security_groups: $sgs } )'
